title: Center anything with flexbox
summary: justify-content + align-items on the parent centers a child on both axes.
explanation: A flex container lays its children out along a main axis (a row by default). justify-content positions them along that axis; align-items positions them on the cross axis.
Both properties go on the parent, never on the child. The parent also needs height to center in: here min-height gives it room.
tryThis: Change justify-content to flex-end or space-between.
Add flex-direction: column and notice the two properties swap roles.
